services.desc: San Marino Tennis Club offers year-round Adult and Junior clinics. Please email programs@sanmarinotennis.org and our staff will help fit you for clinic level. The fee is $35 for members and $45 for guests. For members, please register on CourtReserve. blurb: San Marino Tennis Club is nestled among the beautiful trees of Lacy Park, located in San Marino, CA. The tennis club runs the programs and events that are supported by the San Marino Tennis Foundation (SMTF), a non-profit corporation whose mission is to promote tennis as a recreational activity in the community. The facilities include six championship tennis courts, a pro shop, and locker rooms.
